name: Doom Guard
subjectPrompt: An animated empty suit of ornate but battered plate armor, human-sized, standing watch. The black gap in its raised visor is clearly empty, no eyes, head or skull. From source two borrow the swept visor, layered broad pauldron plates, articulated rounded knee guards, fine engraved trim, chain links and full silhouette. Dark tarnished steel with worn bronze rivets and a muted liver-red cloak behind it. One armored hand grips a plain straight sword held point downward alongside its boot. The other hand is clenched. Retain a slight dark separation between the vambrace and the elbow plate, suggesting an empty construction held together by enchantment. Full front three-quarter figure, both boots visible, no other person or objects.

name: Gnome Vampire
subjectPrompt: An elderly male gnome vampire, deeply aged and wiry with compact gnomish proportions, a bald head ringed by wispy gray hair, pronounced nose, grooved cheeks, parchment-pale skin, and an unsettling wide grin with subtle pointed canines. Small agile frame, clearly visible face and fingers. He wears the dark hooded mantle lowered onto his shoulders, old leather and muted umber robes with a pleated lower hem, wrapped forearms, scuffed wrapped boots and a few remnants of metal ankle chain suggested by the reference. Slightly crouched, one hand half raised, with quiet malice. Full figure from head to feet in one composition. The picture contains no blood, other creatures, bats, gothic arches, crypt scenery or weapons.
